newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sees possible 10-11 pct cost for Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russia sees possible 10-11 pct cost for Eurobond.

text.p: Russia believes it may have to pay 10-11 percent for its forthcoming eurobond, a senior finance ministry official said on Tuesday.
"It may very well be 10 or 11 percent, but we would like to pay less," deputy finance minister Mikhail Kasyanov told Reuters.
He said the exact volume, price, interest rates would be set after the road-show which started on Monday ends on November 21.
Coupons are most likely to be semi-annual, he said.
According to finance ministry estimates, Russian banks will buy up to 25 percent of the issue, the maximum volume of which is $500 million, he said.
"These are our estimates of their financial potential," Kasyanov said.
Russia will issue the Eurobond between November 21 and 25, Finance Minister Alexander Livshits has said previously.
